dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a high degree of falcation with a deep concave spline curvature initiating approximately 40% up from the posterior base towards the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius categorized as rounded-acute at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin presents a relatively straight, slightly convex contour at an approximate 35-45 degree angle relative to the visible horizontal base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 2.6:1 ratio of maximum longitudinal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, irregular notches and indentations are visible along the lower third of the posterior trailing edge. Extensive white punctate scarring or pigmentation spots are distributed across the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'salt-and-pepper' speckled patterning across the entire visible gray integument of the fin.
